newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco denies smelting sale talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco denies smelting sale talks.

text.p: MELBOURNE, Feb 24 (Rueter) - Comalco Ltd denied on Monday market speculation that it was considering selling off its smelting division and abandoning its proposed alumina refinery project.
"The current talk about that (withdrawing from smelting) is one hell of a way wide of the mark," chief executive Terry Palmer todl reporters.
He blamed the speculation on an internal smelting division memo which said the smelting business would refocus away from growth towards operational efficiencies.
Palmer denied any relationship between this memo and its plans to build an alumina refinery in either the Australian state of Queensland or Malaysia or Queensland.
"The position with the alumina project remains unchanged," he said, adding that Comalco wanted to assess final feasibility of the project this year and start building it in 1998.
